fields.name: VCU/CarState/home_mode
fields.doc: Whether or not VCU is in home mode.
fields.desc: In the firmware, this value corresponds to the value of the bool `get_nero_state().home_mode`.

fields.name: VCU/CarState/nero_index
fields.desc: In the firmware, this value corresponds to the value of `get_nero_state().nero_index`, which is of type `nero_menu_t`. 0=OFF, 1=PIT, 2=REVERSE, 3=PERFORMANCE, 4=EFFICIENCY, 5=GAMES, 6=EXIT. This description was last updated on 12/14/2025, so please modify it if there have been any changes in the firmware.

fields.name: VCU/CarState/speed
fields.doc: Speed of the car, in miles per hour.

fields.name: VCU/CarState/tsms
fields.doc: Whether or not shutdown is closed.
fields.desc: Refers to the "Official" TSMS state (not the raw pin state, but the state stored in the debounced 'tsms' bool).

fields.name: VCU/CarState/torque_limit_percentage
fields.doc: The torque limit selected by the driver.

fields.name: VCU/CarState/not_in_reverse
fields.doc: Whether or not the car is in reverse.
fields.desc: '1' means that `cerberus_state.functional != F_REVERSE`. '0' means that 'cerberus_state.functional == F_REVERSE'.

fields.name: VCU/CarState/regen_limit
fields.doc: The regenerative braking current limit (selected by the driver).

fields.name: VCU/CarState/launch_control
fields.doc: Whether or not launch control is enabled.
fields.desc: '1' indicates that launch control is enabled. '0' indicates that launch control is disabled.

fields.name: VCU/CarState/functional_state
fields.desc: Check func_state_t in Cerberus-2.0 to see what each value refers to.

fields.name: VCU/CarState/traction_control
fields.doc: Whether or not traction control is enabled.
fields.desc: '1' = traction control is enabled, '0' = traction control is not enabled.

fields.name: VCU/Pedals/Percentages/acceleration_pedal
fields.doc: How far the acceleration pedal is pressed, ranging from 0 to 1.
fields.desc: '0' corresponds to 0% (pedal is not pressed down at all). '1' corresponds to 100% (pedal is pressed down as far as possible).

fields.name: VCU/Pedals/Percentages/brake_pedal
fields.doc: How far the brake pedal is pressed, ranging from 0 to 1.
fields.desc: '0' corresponds to 0% (pedal is not pressed down at all). '1' corresponds to 100% (pedal is pressed down as far as possible).

fields.name: VCU/Pedals/Voltages/accel_1
fields.doc: Voltage reading from Acceleration Pedal Sensor 1

fields.name: VCU/Pedals/Voltages/accel_2
fields.doc: Voltage reading from Acceleration Pedal Sensor 2

fields.name: VCU/Pedals/Voltages/brake_1
fields.doc: Voltage reading from Brake Pedal Sensor 1

fields.name: VCU/Pedals/Voltages/brake_2
fields.doc: Voltage reading from Brake Pedal Sensor 2

fields.name: VCU/Lightning/Status
fields.desc: 0=LIGHT_OFF, 1=LIGHT_GREEN, 2=LIGHT_RED

fields.desc: Reported by the SHT30.

fields.name: VCU/Temp/Humidity
fields.desc: Reported by the SHT30.

desc: Brake State as reported by VCU

fields.name: VCU/Echo/Brake_State
fields.desc: This value isn't really an echo. It's directly calculated and reported by VCU. But it's used by Argos for the eFuse page.

fields.name: VCU/RTDS/Pin_State
fields.doc: The state of the RTDS Pin.

fields.name: VCU/RTDS/Sounding_State
fields.doc: Whether or not the RTDS system is attempting to sound the main continuous RTDS sound.
fields.desc: This is not the same as the pure RTDS pin state. This refers to whether or not the RTDS Timer is active, indicating that the car is actively trying to make the sound.

fields.name: VCU/RTDS/Reverse_State
fields.doc: Whether or not the RTDS system is attempting to sound the reverse sound.
fields.desc: This is not the same as the pure RTDS pin state. This refers to whether or not the Reverse Sound Timer is active, indicating whether or not the RTDS system is trying to make the beeping sound.

fields.name: VCU/RTDS/Error_State
fields.doc: Indicates if an error occured during reading.

fields.name: VCU/LVBox/Fan_PWM
fields.desc: Range from 0 to 100. This is the commanded fan PWM duty cycle in percent.(0% at 20°C and 100% at 40°C).
